purpose: Mac-side re-profiling of the two tracked non-cold scenarios (streaming per-delta chain with an open find bar; activity/edit-stats derivation), as required by candidate-queue item 1's 're-profile before opening a round'. Produced the round-12 candidate and re-ranked the queue.
method: PerfRunner job 12-round12-attr (script archived as xctrace-streaming-activity.job in the round worktree's .local; runner log 12-round12-attr.log). Temporary attribution-only bench modes streaming-profile/activity-profile loop the existing benches for 20s each (never committed; porcelain 0 before and after). xcrun xctrace Time Profiler over the whole process; attribution only, never a timing source. Region tables: macos-xctrace-streaming-attribution.txt / macos-xctrace-activity-attribution.txt (analyzer: analyze_streaming_activity.py, same innermost-matching-frame method as round 11).

streaming_profile.setup_note: The loop re-runs the whole bench, so JSON fixture encoding + wire decoding (setup-json 27.79%, setup-wire-decode 3.11%) is classified apart; %nonsetup below excludes it.

conclusions: Streaming with an open find bar is dominated by ConversationSearch: 52.6% of all samples (76.2% of non-setup). The per-delta update re-ran locale matching (case+diacritic folding via CFStringFindWithOptionsAndLocale -> language identification, DataDetectors lexer/token scanning, cluster folding ~13.4% of all samples in leaves) plus UTF-16 index conversion and excerpt building over every latest-turn entry, including entries whose messages were unchanged and whose rendered text cache already hit. Round-12 candidate: per-entry reuse of the whole hit list under (messages, isRunning, query, options) validation.
The model chain around it is now small: tool-visibility 2.7%, timeline-entry 2.4%, model-update 2.1%, narrative 0.55%, turn-summary 0.48% of all samples (rounds 8/9/11 landed).
edit-stats is ~0 in the streaming profile: the status line derives only the current turn, so per-delta streaming pays no whole-window SessionEditStats cost.

Activity bench: SessionEditStats.derive is 57.3% of measured samples; leaves are iterator element copies in tally (IndexingIterator.next() 8.64% self) and the lineCount byte-loop closure (5.24%). running-ids (ToolVisibilityProjection) 18.3% is refcount/dict-hash dominated. activity-init is down to 7.8% (round 9 held). These become the next queue items.

Environment side finding (job 12-round12-diag): bare swiftc standalone binaries are SIGKILLed on the mini (hello-world reproduces in /tmp and $HOME, exit 137); SwiftPM-built binaries run fine. Ad-hoc Mac measurement must use SwiftPM scratch packages; interpreter-mode microbenchmarks are invalid for this kind of code.
